1	import { formatLine, formatUsd } from './format.ts'
2	
3	export interface LineItem {
4	  description: string
5	  unitPriceUsd: number
6	  quantity: number
7	}
8	
9	/** The undiscounted amount for one line. */
10	export function lineTotal(item: LineItem): number {
11	  return item.unitPriceUsd * item.quantity
12	}
13	
14	/**
15	 * The invoice total, in dollars, rounded to cents.
16	 *
17	 * BUG: multiplying by 100 before rounding inherits the binary floating-point
18	 * representation error, so a total of 1.005 becomes 100.49999999999999 and
19	 * rounds down to 1.00 instead of 1.01.
20	 */
21	export function invoiceTotal(items: readonly LineItem[]): number {
22	  const raw = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + lineTotal(item), 0)
23	  return Math.round(raw * 100) / 100
24	}
25	
26	/** The whole invoice as plain text, one line per item plus a total row. */
27	export function renderInvoice(items: readonly LineItem[]): string {
28	  const rows = items.map(item => formatLine(item.description, lineTotal(item)))
29	  return [...rows, formatLine('Total', invoiceTotal(items))].join('\n')
30	}
